verdict.rationale: Notion markets AI agents ("Keep work moving 24/7 with agents") and provides API/webhooks/integrations that could underpin agent workflows, but there is no documentation describing an in-product interface for users to build, configure, or customize their own AI agent (e.g., defining instructions, tools, triggers). Missing for 10: dedicated agent-builder UI documentation, configuration options (tools/instructions/knowledge sources), and independent hands-on confirmation of building a custom agent.
